title: DATEADD to dates the Date table does not have gives an empty table, and the measure is BLANK
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( VAR R = DATEADD ( 'Date'[Date], -1, MONTH ) RETURN ROW ( "Rows", COUNTROWS ( R ) + 0, "Sales", CALCULATE ( [Sales], R ) ), 'Date'[Date] >= DATE ( 2023, 1, 1 ) && 'Date'[Date] <= DATE ( 2023, 1, 31 ) )

source.quote: The result table includes only dates that exist in the dates column.
source.supports: dates outside the Date table are not returned

source.quote: This example shows the sales in the current and previous month.
source.supports: in the example table the first month of the Date table shows (Blank) for "Same period last month"

derivation: January 2023 is the first month of the Date table. Moved back a month it would be December 2022, which the table does not have, so the result has no rows (COUNTROWS is BLANK, + 0 makes it 0). A filter with no rows leaves no Sales rows: [Sales] is BLANK.
notes: The type of the BLANK [Sales] column is not asserted.
